sql_templates.template:
WITH recent_breadth AS (
    SELECT sector, AVG(pct_above_50dma) AS avg_pct_50dma, AVG(change_5d) AS avg_change_5d
    FROM breadth.sector_daily
    WHERE snapshot_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 DAYS' AND CURRENT_DATE
    GROUP BY sector
),
featured_sectors AS (
    SELECT sb.sector, st.stage2_pct
    FROM recent_breadth sb
    JOIN breadth.ma_pct_above st ON sb.sector = st.sector
    WHERE st.snapshot_date = CURRENT_DATE
)
SELECT *
FROM featured_sectors
WHERE avg_change_5d > 2
ORDER BY stage2_pct DESC;
